draft.subject: Your SSO question + getting your first project up
draft.body:
Hi Wei,

Thanks for your note about SSO for your organization — your ticket is still open with us and Tariq is following up. For context, SSO is available on the Team plan.

In the meantime, you don't need to wait on that to get value: projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them, and the in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project. A teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time.

Would a short call this week help? I'm happy to walk through setting up your first project with you.

Best,
Priya
